title: Bioweapon Prevention Act of 2025
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
summary:
Bioweapon Prevention Act of 2025

This bill prohibits federal funding for any research center or laboratory in which a national of a country of concern conducts agricultural research. Under the bill, a country of concern includes Cuba, Iran, Russia, China, Venezuela, and North Korea.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
